observation.visible_scene: A LEGO Technic mechanism on a gray studded baseplate against a plain light-gray background. A vertical gray beam stands at center; mounted at its upper right are a black tire and a gray toothed gear on a horizontal shaft. On the left face of the beam a black cam (marked with a white cross) rotates on a shaft facing the viewer, carrying an offset yellow pin. A red rocker arm is hinged at its lower end to a gray pivot block (via a short red angled link) and reaches up so that its yellow-pin hole rides against the rotating cam. A blue curved tube and a translucent clear tube connect to a gray block on the right. The whole rig is otherwise static.
visible_changes: The black cam rotates continuously throughout the segment; the white cross on its face changes orientation frame by frame, and the offset yellow pin travels around the cam's circumference.

The red rocker arm oscillates about its lower pivot as the cam's pin pushes it: it swings from a left-tilted pose toward vertical, then to a right-tilted pose, then back through vertical to a left tilt, repeating over the excerpt (no rest at either crop boundary).
The base pivot, gray block, red angled link, blue tube, clear tube, vertical beam, tire and gear remain fixed in position; the background is unchanged, indicating no camera motion.
The top red pin and the yellow-pin hole on the rocker translate horizontally in sync with the rocker's swing.
outside_clip_unknowns: What drives the cam's rotation (motor or hand cranking) is not shown.
Whether the oscillation continues, stops, or changes amplitude after the last frame is unknown.
The function of the clear and blue tubes (fluid/air path) is not demonstrated within the segment.
uncertain_details: Whether the large black tire and gray gear actually rotate is not confirmable from these frames (the tire has no visible spokes and gear-tooth shifts are indistinct).
The exact phase and number of complete oscillation cycles are approximate; motion is already underway at t=0 and still ongoing at t=1.333.
